book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: 1 TIMOTI Poloto Timotina Pepa Bulupane Peyo Pee Leane Oko

content: Gotena Piape Oko Kuai Lo Pua Atape Leane Oko

Oli Sipitisa okomane pii panakame loto, matili sipitisa koo atene akali minditupa-mane mana koo miniyama nembo natene, wandakali yangone tupa andakasa wato, owato pii minditupa lolopeyai leya. Owato potopesa akali utupane-mane wandakali yangone tupa mana lamaulai-kola, wandakali minditupa-mane owato sipitisa utupanena pii lolai tupa ale wato, Gotena pii layene enene oko bilipi leyai okone awua tepa olopeyai.

Owato pii lalaini akali utupane-mane pii lolai oko loto, akali yame yakamato wanda kee nalene kondalu, wanda yame yakama akali puu napene kondalu, piyapape lolopeyai. Gote lo bilipi lene wandakali nanimato Gotena pii enene oko kuai lo nembo teyama. Pii okonemane loto, wamba Goteto minditaka eya tupa pitaka yakale lea-angi, balato utupane pitaka epene teke-teke eya leaipia. Nanimato Gotena pii okone nembo toto, bala ando pote loloma-kola, tunduma-pene yame tupa pitaka epene wete yolopeya. Goteto minditaka yakale leane utupane pitaka epene teke-teke yakale lea-kola, nanimato utupanena mindi koo ya loto, mo apia napipe-pene. Goteto minditaka yakale leane mindi moloma-angi, nanimato bala ando wayu pele lalu, miape-pene. Gotena pii okonemane nanima languato, yakamato bala ando wayu pele loto, tomo balato yakale leane tupa pitaka nalapale nembo toto, balato tomo utupane pitaka yakale leane leya. Gotena pii okonemane wuane leya tekeko, owato pii lalaini akali tupamane Gotena pii okone awua tepa alu, tomo utupanena minditupa nanene kondalapa lolopeyai.

Gotena pii layene eya tupamane nimba minu tai laya ola-kola, nimbato balana mana epene tupa wato minuto, mana utupane Kitisene amene imalini ima mana lamawua ateendo, nimba Jisasa Kataisana piape akali epene atolopele.

Saka atalane Goteto wandakali pitaka taputi pua moyalane tekeko, balato bala lo bilipi lene wandakali tupa wayumane wetete taputi pua moyalane. Tene okonena, balato nanima moyolo-peya lo nanimato balanga tungi peyoto, ayiawa wete balana piape oko taimane pua atalamane. Wandakali mindimane bala tanena umbaini oko mo tai laya oyale, mangene minditupa peando, mana okonemane bala aŋako moyolo-peya tekeko, balato Gotena mana tupa wato mineyo nayu mineando, mana okonemane andipapi, matili matilipi, bala wayumane wete moyolo-peya layene eya. Wandakali pitaka-mane pii okone enene wete eya lo bilipi leyama nayu lape-pene. Tene okonena, owato potopisa akali tupamane mee pii temane tupapi, pii okonepene waka tupapi, utupane lolai-angi, nimbato pii utupane ale naene masia mawua atoto, Gotena pii oko wato minukale nembo toto, balana mana oko mo atape.
Nimbato mana utupane wandakali waka tupa lamawuato, mana utupane wato minalapape lo lamaipe.

Wandakali mindikipi mindimane nimba iwana patane atele loto, nimba anda napi leakale lo nimbato ando konda napipe. Jia. Kitisene wandakali tupamane nimbana mana wato mineakale nembo toto, nimbato Kataisa lo bilipi leyo nayu loto, wandakali tupa towa epelewa yamapane yo atoto, pii lole tupapi, mana minule tupapi, utupane pitaka kuai lo angu minu atape.

Nimbato namba epolopeya lo maliyo atoto, wandakali-mane Gotena pii pepa pelene eya oko ale yakale nembo toto, nimbato Gotena pii dii lape. Dii lalu, pii okonena dini tupa mana lamawuato, wandakali tupamane Gotena mana epene tupa wato mineakale loto, nimbato utupane mina ika lape.

Wamba Gotena piape ando atalaini akali minditupa-mane nimbana kawanenga kii yata yai-kola, akali mindi bala potopesa akali mindi gulo atoto, nimbato Gotena piape tupa pulupele lea-kola, Goteto balana piape pulane tai-lene oko nimba gea. Balana piape pulane tai-lene nimbanga eya okone mee yakale lo ando konda naene, nimbato balana piape pua atape.
Nimbato piape pua atele oko epene guu lama-lama peya oko wandakali pitaka-mane andeakale nembo toto, ole dindi lo nimbato Gotena piape peyo nayu, taimane pua atape.

Nimba tane mana minule tupa anu pua miniyope lo ando atoto, mana lamaule tupa nimbato anu pua mana lamaiyope lo ando atape. Nimbato wuane pua ateendo, Goteto nimbapi, nimbana pii alewa ateyai wandakali tupapi, yakama pitaka taputi pua molo-peke lolopeya. Goteto wuane pulupeya nembo toto, nimbato Gotena piape utupane pua atape.
